notes: Released October 7, 2026. Microsoft Foundry lists both Azure-hosted and Anthropic-hosted Haiku 5.5 as GA through native Messages. No independent maximum input limit is inferred from its context window.

Adaptive thinking defaults on with medium effort. Disabled thinking is supported at high effort or below; manual budget_tokens and non-default temperature/top_p/top_k are rejected by the upstream. Forced tool_choice any/tool is supported but produces no thinking block.
Thinking blocks are account-bound or usable by linked accounts; replay them unchanged through the producing account. The newer tokenizer can count approximately 30% more tokens than Haiku 4.5.

Prompts up to and including 100K tokens use the short rates; larger prompts use the long rates for the whole request, including cache reads and TTL-specific writes. Batch discounts and deployment-specific surcharges are not represented by these standard Anthropic prices.

The 128K output limit is for synchronous Messages. The separate Message Batches API supports 300K output with the output-300k-2026-03-24 beta header; that batch-only limit is not applied to proxy Messages routes.
